chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
When the man forces the woman upon herself, he should be struck with one stroke of the sword, either he dies from it or lives.

key_terms.ضُرِبَ: He was struck (passive verb indicating punishment)
key_terms.كَابَرَ: To force or compel someone against their will

ai.seo_question: What is the punishment for a man who rapes a woman according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi outlines the judicial penalty (jara') for a man who rapes a woman, prescribing a single sword strike that may result in death or survival, distinguishing it from fixed hudud punishments. In Shia jurisprudence, this is often interpreted as a discretionary penalty (ta'zir) or a specific form of execution, emphasizing the severity of violating the woman's chastity against her will. The ruling underscores the legal protection of women's bodily autonomy and the gravity of sexual coercion in Islamic law.
